acceptanceCriteria: A1: v0.2.26 version, documentation and tri-language parity rows are internally consistent before release verification.
A2: the immutable v0.2.26 tag is created only on a merged PR commit with a valid premerge-finalize receipt and release-tag ancestor proof.
A3: the public v0.2.26 artifact is downloaded and verified by the release adopter and upgrade acceptance scripts with no source, workspace, or local-target fallback.
A4: isolated adopter evidence proves repository identity, runtime identity, forbidden HOME/XDG writes, classified TMPDIR/CARGO_HOME writes, root cleanup, and SHA256 binding.
A5: the installed public v0.2.26 Runtime completes WI-209 finalize, finalize-verify, and structured human close after merge, with visible tri-language Outcome evidence.
A6: v0.2.25 remains immutable failed publication history and is never moved, overwritten, or reused as a successful Release.
goal: 从合并后的默认分支建立可审计的 v0.2.26 不可变发布、公开 adopter 验收与 WI-209 Runtime transition 收尾。
intent: 发布 v0.2.26，使用公开 Release binary 从零验收 adopter/upgrade 隔离，并完成当前发布治理链的 finalize、verify 与 structured close。
outOfScope: or reusing the immutable v0.2.25 tag
New runtime feature implementation unrelated to release integrity
